solver.note: The run configuration is recorded because a value reproduces only under the conditions that produced it. Distributed and iterative solvers are not bit-reproducible across core counts, so a stability comparison is valid only against a matching configuration.

input.note: The generator commit is recorded separately from the deck hash. A generator change that regenerates an identical deck leaves the hash unchanged; a generator change that alters the deck invalidates this golden even though the byte-match guard would still pass, because that guard compares the deck to the generator rather than either to a comparator.

comparator.inputs: ri = 750 mm, ro = 810 mm, P = 10 MPa
comparator.exactness_note: sigma_z is exactly zero rather than approximately so. The deck applies pressure to the inner line only, with no end cap and a free top edge. For the Lame field sigma_r + sigma_theta is constant through the wall, so the axial strain is uniform and u_z = eps_zz * z satisfies the bottom-edge UY restraint identically. The restraint therefore introduces no corner disturbance and the comparison carries no idealisation error of its own.
comparator.residual_note: The 0.55 percent deviation is mesh discretisation: ESIZE is wall_t/4, giving four elements through a 60 mm wall.

equilibrium.criterion: Both reactions shall be zero to solver precision. A non-zero axial reaction indicates an unintended load or restraint; a non-zero radial reaction cannot arise unless a radial restraint has been re-introduced, which is the defect this issue removed.

acceptance.basis: ASME VIII membrane allowable for SA-516 Gr 70 at the design temperature
acceptance.note: Peak von Mises is 51.8 percent of the 260 MPa stated yield, so the linear-elastic idealisation is comfortably inside its validity range. The superseded 30 mm parameterisation reached 99.8 percent of yield, which it was not.

peak_location.note: Recorded so the reported peak can be distinguished from a mesh-dependent singularity. For this model the peak is the inner-fibre hoop stress, which converges; the node is captured as standing practice rather than because this case is at risk.
